name: Checklist
description: A tab where a person works through a list of manual checks an agent wrote, and the agent gets the result back to fix what failed.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Reads the checklist file an agent wrote in the workspace, keeps your answers in the kit's own data folder, and sends the agent that asked a plain summary of the results. Changes no project file.

path.description: The checklist, a JSON file the agent wrote in the workspace, relative to its folder and not hidden: recette/login.json. It holds { "title": "...", "steps": [ { "text": "what to do", "expect": "what the person should see" } ] }. One tab per path.
